definitions.area: The region enclosed by a plane figure, measured in square units.
definitions.composite figure: A figure assembled from smaller shapes whose areas may be added or subtracted.
definitions.apothem: The perpendicular distance from a regular polygon's center to a side.
definitions.semiperimeter: Half the perimeter of a triangle, as used in Heron's formula.
definitions.precision: How finely a measured quantity is reported, without overstating accuracy.
definitions.relative error: Absolute error divided by the absolute accepted value when nonzero.
definitions.geometric probability: The ratio of favorable geometric measure to total measure for a uniform choice.
definitions.optimization: Choosing the best feasible value of an objective under constraints.
